capabilities: Converts Markdown notes, including highlights and task lists, into self-contained HTML
Manages shareable style presets with JSON import and export
Defines reusable style variables with a built-in color picker
Customizes element and inline CSS for headings, lists, blockquotes, and dividers
Exports HTML files beside the source note or to a custom directory
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not render HTML inside notes; it exports Markdown notes as standalone HTML files with inline styles.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true) because exporting to custom directories outside the vault uses Node.js node:fs/promises and node:path.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export notes as standalone HTML documents with custom inline CSS tuned for publishing platforms.
summary: Markdown-to-HTML exporter that turns notes into self-contained HTML documents with customizable inline CSS style presets.
